PC Errata 2013 slip of [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm]]: a printed slip of the whole card except the picture (both text strips, with their icons), meant to be placed over the original card, titled “• Tatooine: Lars’ Moisture Farm”. Cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 29 of the sheet. Source: Players Committee, ''Decipher Errata'' sheet (“Official text as of January 1, 2013”), [http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf DecipherErrata.pdf], PDF page 29; the PDF was made on 16 April 2013 (file metadata). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Internet Archive] (9 August 2016; SHA-1 of the archived file 3453cd4bee7d22faa58e3cfa492bea8021b2578c). Shown on [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (PC Errata 2013 slip)]].
